verdict.rationale: The IRS publishes an exact paper and fax fallback for EIN applications: mail or fax Form SS-4 to Internal Revenue Service, Attn: EIN Operation, Cincinnati, OH 45999, Fax 855-641-6935 (irs-supp-4). That rail covers the online assistant's limited operating hours and its 15-minute session expiry (irs-supp-1, irs-supp-3). The 83(b) election also has a documented paper rail via a written statement or Form 15620 (irs-supp-11), but it points only to 'the Service Center where you file your return'. Missing for 10: exact mailing addresses for the 83(b) paper rail in the evidence, fallback coordinates for applicants outside the 50 states/DC, independent or hands-on corroboration that the fallback works.
